pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(gentle solo piano, sparse and warm)

[Verse 1]
Side by side, not rushing.
The piano says side by side, not rushing more quietly than I do.
I stay with Walking Level and do not rename it.

[Pre-Chorus]
The evening keeps Walking Level and nothing larger.
Walking Level is only the name I give this hour.

[Chorus]
I leave Walking Level where the light already was.
Side by side, not rushing, and the cup stays where I set it.
I write Walking Level in the margin and close the page.

[Verse 2]
A window holds Walking Level a little longer.
Side by side, not rushing.

[Piano Solo]
(expressive melodic piano solo, sustained and tender)

[Bridge]
I stay with Walking Level and do not rename it.
The evening keeps Walking Level and nothing larger.

[Chorus]
I leave Walking Level where the light already was.
Side by side, not rushing, and the cup stays where I set it.
I write Walking Level in the margin and close the page.

[Outro]
(solo piano fades into soft residual notes)
The piano says side by side, not rushing more quietly than I do.
